BLOCK REALM

Build it. Share it. Sleep through the night.

SETTINGS

Choose a world

Mouse: look · WASD: move · Space: jump · Shift: run
Left click: break a block · Right click: place the selected block
1-8 or mouse wheel: choose an inventory slot · E: block catalog (add or remove blocks)
Right click a door: open or close it · Q at a door: set or open its password (multiplayer)
Right click a bed at night: go to sleep
M: sound effects on or off · Esc: pause and save
Double-tap Space: fly (Space up, Shift down) · T: chat with other players (multiplayer)
V: talk to players close to you (voice chat, multiplayer)

Touch: drag the circle on the left to walk, drag anywhere else to look.
Tap anywhere to place the selected block there. Hold still on a block to break it. BREAK breaks the block in the middle of the screen. JUMP jumps. BAG opens the block catalog. DOOR (shown when you look at a door) sets or opens its password. MENU pauses.

ADMIN CODE

Enter your admin code. Codes are checked by the server, so you must be connected to a multiplayer server.

Game creator only. While this is on you can break any player's blocks and open any locked door.

Wall hacks let you fly straight through walls and floors, and see other players through them.

While you are invisible, other players cannot see you or your name, and you do not appear on their screens.
